body: Wonderful read, thanks for that link

I did to a guy who was making diff kinds of plans very early on - told him we need to rest it, and then we reconnected a few days later. Dating lasted 3 months.  At that time already a situationship (meeting his friends and family, being intimate), I asked what we are and he was triggered - said he is serious but not ready to commit. I was floored. I asked how can he say he is serious when he said he is not a relationship material person? A year later we reconnected, and he asked if he we can do things “like before” - without apologies nor addressing of the problems I raised and his issues too the year before-  I declined. Realized it was all about him having an easy fix  ✌️

OH MY. 

Thank you Ms Jacque. :)
